mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD CII USING (
SELECT '${item.partyType3}' PARTY_TYPE3, '${item.partyType2}' PARTY_TYPE2, '${item.partyType1}' PARTY_TYPE1, '${item.industry}' INDUSTRY, '${item.industry2}' INDUSTRY2, '${item.insitituteCode}' INSITITUTE_CODE, '${item.isGov}' IS_GOV, ${item.mainCapital}null MAIN_CAPITAL, ${item.registerCapital}null REGISTER_CAPITAL, '${item.province}' PROVINCE, '${item.city}' CITY, '${item.county}' COUNTY, '${item.holdingType}' HOLDING_TYPE, '${item.customerObjType}' CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE, '${item.isListedCompany}' IS_LISTED_COMPANY, '${item.isGroupCustomer}' IS_GROUP_CUSTOMER, '${item.parentCustomerId}' PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID, '${item.parentCustomerName}' PARENT_CUSTOMER_NAME, '${item.isPrivate}' IS_PRIVATE, '${item.isEscapeDept}' IS_ESCAPE_DEPT, '${item.creditType}' CREDIT_TYPE, '${item.isCreditRelatedTrd}' IS_CREDIT_RELATED_TRD, '${item.structAdjustType}' STRUCT_ADJUST_TYPE, '${item.indusUpgrateType}' INDUS_UPGRATE_TYPE, '${item.busiScope}' BUSI_SCOPE, '${item.mainBusi}' MAIN_BUSI, '${item.sex}' SEX, '${item.personId}' PERSON_ID, '${item.mPhone}' M_PHONE, '${item.phone}' PHONE, '${item.position}' POSITION, '${item.companyName}' COMPANY_NAME, '${item.address}' ADDRESS, '${item.mail}' MAIL, '${item.property}' PROPERTY, '${item.companyNature}' COMPANY_NATURE, '${item.linkId1}' LINK_ID1, '${item.linkId2}' LINK_ID2, '${item.linkId3}' LINK_ID3, '${item.remark}' REMARK, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, '${item.createDept}' CREATE_DEPT, current date CREATE_TIME, '${item.updateUser}' UPDATE_USER, current date UPDATE_TIME, '${item.customerId}' CUSTOMER_ID FROM sysibm.SYSDUMMY1
) TEMP
ON(CII.CUSTOMER_ID = TEMP.CUSTOMER_ID )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PARTY_TYPE3 = TEMP.PARTY_TYPE3, PARTY_TYPE2 = TEMP.PARTY_TYPE2, PARTY_TYPE1 = TEMP.PARTY_TYPE1, INDUSTRY = TEMP.INDUSTRY, INDUSTRY2 = TEMP.INDUSTRY2, INSITITUTE_CODE = TEMP.INSITITUTE_CODE, IS_GOV = TEMP.IS_GOV, MAIN_CAPITAL = TEMP.MAIN_CAPITAL, REGISTER_CAPITAL = TEMP.REGISTER_CAPITAL, PROVINCE = TEMP.PROVINCE, CITY = TEMP.CITY, COUNTY = TEMP.COUNTY, HOLDING_TYPE = TEMP.HOLDING_TYPE, CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE = TEMP.CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE, IS_LISTED_COMPANY = TEMP.IS_LISTED_COMPANY, IS_GROUP_CUSTOMER = TEMP.IS_GROUP_CUSTOMER, PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID = TEMP.PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID, PARENT_CUSTOMER_NAME = TEMP.PARENT_CUSTOMER_NAME, IS_PRIVATE = TEMP.IS_PRIVATE, IS_ESCAPE_DEPT = TEMP.IS_ESCAPE_DEPT, CREDIT_TYPE = TEMP.CREDIT_TYPE, IS_CREDIT_RELATED_TRD = TEMP.IS_CREDIT_RELATED_TRD, STRUCT_ADJUST_TYPE = TEMP.STRUCT_ADJUST_TYPE, INDUS_UPGRATE_TYPE = TEMP.INDUS_UPGRATE_TYPE, BUSI_SCOPE = TEMP.BUSI_SCOPE, MAIN_BUSI = TEMP.MAIN_BUSI, SEX = TEMP.SEX, PERSON_ID = TEMP.PERSON_ID, M_PHONE = TEMP.M_PHONE, PHONE = TEMP.PHONE, POSITION = TEMP.POSITION, COMPANY_NAME = TEMP.COMPANY_NAME, ADDRESS = TEMP.ADDRESS, MAIL = TEMP.MAIL, PROPERTY = TEMP.PROPERTY, COMPANY_NATURE = TEMP.COMPANY_NATURE, LINK_ID1 = TEMP.LINK_ID1, LINK_ID2 = TEMP.LINK_ID2, LINK_ID3 = TEMP.LINK_ID2, REMARK = TEMP.REMARK, CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CUSTOMER_ID, PARTY_TYPE3, PARTY_TYPE2, PARTY_TYPE1, INDUSTRY, INDUSTRY2, INSITITUTE_CODE, IS_GOV, MAIN_CAPITAL, REGISTER_CAPITAL, PROVINCE, CITY, COUNTY, HOLDING_TYPE, CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE, IS_LISTED_COMPANY, IS_GROUP_CUSTOMER, PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID, PARENT_CUSTOMER_NAME, IS_PRIVATE, IS_ESCAPE_DEPT, CREDIT_TYPE, IS_CREDIT_RELATED_TRD, STRUCT_ADJUST_TYPE, INDUS_UPGRATE_TYPE, BUSI_SCOPE, MAIN_BUSI, SEX, PERSON_ID, M_PHONE, PHONE, POSITION, COMPANY_NAME, ADDRESS, MAIL, PROPERTY, COMPANY_NATURE, LINK_ID1, LINK_ID2, LINK_ID3, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (TEMP.CUSTOMER_ID, TEMP.PARTY_TYPE3, TEMP.PARTY_TYPE2, TEMP.PARTY_TYPE1, TEMP.INDUSTRY, TEMP.INDUSTRY2, TEMP.INSITITUTE_CODE, TEMP.IS_GOV, TEMP.MAIN_CAPITAL, TEMP.REGISTER_CAPITAL, TEMP.PROVINCE, TEMP.CITY, TEMP.COUNTY, TEMP.HOLDING_TYPE, TEMP.CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE, TEMP.IS_LISTED_COMPANY, TEMP.IS_GROUP_CUSTOMER, TEMP.PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID, TEMP.PARENT_CUSTOMER_NAME, TEMP.IS_PRIVATE, TEMP.IS_ESCAPE_DEPT, TEMP.CREDIT_TYPE, TEMP.IS_CREDIT_RELATED_TRD, TEMP.STRUCT_ADJUST_TYPE, TEMP.INDUS_UPGRATE_TYPE, TEMP.BUSI_SCOPE, TEMP.MAIN_BUSI, TEMP.SEX, TEMP.PERSON_ID, TEMP.M_PHONE, TEMP.PHONE, TEMP.POSITION, TEMP.COMPANY_NAME, TEMP.ADDRESS, TEMP.MAIL, TEMP.PROPERTY, TEMP.COMPANY_NATURE, TEMP.LINK_ID1, TEMP.LINK_ID2, TEMP.LINK_ID3, TEMP.REMARK, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME)
